beats.headline: Not consumable
beats.text: Carl's head is starting to clear, and Donut reels off the haul. They got another combo card, a unique one called Golden Combo: it works the same way as the last, but it is not consumable, so she can do it over and over. Imagine the possibilities. With the new cards, she says, she is pretty much indestructible, and maybe she can do this last fight by herself. Carl asks whether that is a joke. Not even a little bit.

beats.headline: In Carl's hand
beats.text: On the beach with the deck in his control, Carl draws a hand of the Midnight Express, still persistent, the Golden Combo, which would let him temporarily combine two totems, a Time Extend, and the card he wants, Raul the crab. They are a totem short because Donut used the Golden Combo to fuse Lazarus with Skylar Spinach and then made the fusion permanent with Ren's Glow Up.

beats.headline: Combined with Shi Maria
beats.text: Donut's hand: Alpha Carl, Shi Maria, the Golden Combo and a snare, and no Flee cards anywhere in the deck. Carl tells her to summon Shi Maria and Alpha Carl and combine them. Both appear, the spider far too tall for the hallway, metal snapping as her legs snake in. Donut tosses out the Golden Combo. Shi Maria shoves a leg through the back of Alpha Carl's head. The intended target of the Golden Combo has been incapacitated, the System announces, so it proceeds to the next available minion target. That's you. Carl has been combined with Shi Maria.

beats.headline: Not that one either
beats.text: One card may come with them past the collapse. Donut had meant it to be Lazarus or the Golden Combo, and now she offers Paz's card instead, in case there is a way to set him free. Carl remembers Paz's face the last time Sister Ines summoned him: please, no more. They should never have let her turn him into a card, and it was his fault. And they are not taking the Golden Combo card either.
